purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
audit_findings: The condition occurrence, disease terminology concept, diagnosis assertion, observation, care record and public-health case remain distinct.
The required WM-LIV-002 organism link establishes the subject but does not import organism mastership.
The incoming WM-ACT-049 relation remains an optional care-context reference and cannot control condition identity.
Clinical status, verification status and record status are independent axes and no one axis is inferred from another.
Onset, manifestation, recognition, diagnosis, recording, remission, relapse, recurrence and resolution remain distinct clocks or events.
Severity, stage, course, etiology, functional impact and prognosis are source-qualified assessments rather than timeless truths.
Association is not promoted to causation, susceptibility to disease, remission to cure, recurrence to duplication or prognosis to outcome.
Human and non-human use requires explicit terminology, evidence, access and governance profiles.
Protected condition data remains deny-by-default, purpose-bound, minimum-necessary and auditable.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
